info.name: IAM Assignment - Complete
info.description: All 39 Section D routes plus OIDC/DCR checks. Run selected folders against an isolated test environment. Token, password, identity and cleanup folders require deliberate manual setup. Use a user authorization-code + S256 PKCE access token; machine tokens cannot impersonate users. Never export populated secrets.

item.name: Get user token with Postman OAuth helper

request.description: In Authorization choose Get New Access Token, Authorize using browser, Authorization Code (With PKCE), SHA-256, Basic header client authentication. Sign in as an authorized internal user. Copy the access token into user_access_token for the remaining folders; use an ADMIN account for administrative routes.

exec: pm.test("No credential or provider snapshot fields", () => { const text=pm.response.text(); ["passwordHash","password_hash","providerAttributes"].forEach(key => pm.expect(text).not.to.include("\""+key+"\"")); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body=pm.response.json(); if (body.access_token !== undefined) pm.environment.set("user_access_token", body.access_token); if (body.refresh_token !== undefined) pm.environment.set("user_refresh_token", body.refresh_token); }

request.description: Administrative routes require exact resource:action authorities. Identity IDs must belong to the selected internal owner; no endpoint accepts unvalidated provider proof.

exec: pm.test("No credential or provider snapshot fields", () => { const text=pm.response.text(); ["passwordHash","password_hash","providerAttributes"].forEach(key => pm.expect(text).not.to.include("\""+key+"\"")); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body=pm.response.json(); if (body.uuid !== undefined) pm.environment.set("registered_user_uuid", body.uuid); }
